BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   C. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   B. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   D. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

5. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

6. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

7. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   C. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

10. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.

12. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   B. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   C. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.

14. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   C. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.

15. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

16. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   D. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
